AssayIndex per INT-018 (repo layout: .assay/assay-index.v1.json + runs/<run-id>/) and INT-019 (runId is the stable dedupe key). schemaVersion pinned to major 1, FB-RAT-COM-003. title: AssayIndex
description: The top-level manifest at .assay/assay-index.v1.json, committed by Assay to a user-selected branch after a scan run. Fonebrew Core reads this only when the user selects a repo+branch and taps 'Check branch' (INT-020 — Studio never invokes or polls Assay). findingFiles/provingTests here are SUMMARY entries (path/sha256/count, or path/count) pointing at the detailed content living alongside this index — findings.sarif (+ optional findings.json companion) and runs/<run-id>/proving-tests.v1.json (schemas/integrations/proving-tests.v1.schema.json) respectively; this schema does not repeat their contents.

schemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH of this index shape. A reader MUST reject any schemaVersion whose major is not '1' with IMPORT_UNSUPPORTED_MAJOR (FB-RAT-COM-003).

runId.description: Stable dedupe key for this Assay run (INT-019). Also names the runs/<runId>/ directory this index's findingFiles/provingTests paths are relative to.

sourceCommit.description: The commit of the SCANNED repository (not the Assay output branch) this run's findings apply to — what Core resolves and reads when the user later promotes a finding into an Incident, so the source link stays pinned even if the branch moves on.

assayCommit.description: The commit ON the Assay output branch that carries this exact index + runs/<runId>/ tree — the commit the user explicitly committed/pushed (INT-018 flow step 2).

findingFiles.description: One entry per findings output file this run produced (typically one findings.sarif, optionally a findings.json normalized companion).

completeness.description: Whether every configured scanner (MobSF/OSV-Scanner/Semgrep/Gitleaks per this repo's SOLE-finding-source rule) ran to completion. COMPLETE means all did; PARTIAL/FAILED require `explanation` (structurally enforced below) — a run MUST NOT silently under-report scanner coverage.

explanation.description: Human-readable reason, required non-blank whenever completeness is PARTIAL or FAILED (e.g. 'OSV-Scanner timed out after 10m; MobSF/Semgrep/Gitleaks completed'). MUST be null-or-absent to non-blank only per the if/then below — never a placeholder string standing in for a real reason.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).

gitRemote.description: The scanned repository's git remote URL, the primary identity Core matches against when the user selects repo+branch.

fonebrewProjectHint.description: Optional Fonebrew project id Assay was told about at scan time, offered as a convenience default only — Core MUST still require the explicit repo+branch selection + 'Check branch' tap (INT-012, INT-020) before reading anything; this hint is never auto-applied.

path.description: Path relative to runs/<runId>/, e.g. 'findings.sarif'. A reader MUST reject any path containing a '..' segment (see fixtures/integrations/adversarial for the equivalent common-domain pattern this mirrors) before opening it.

sha256.description: Digest of the exact bytes at `path` (FB-RAT-COM-005). Core MUST recompute and compare this before trusting the file's contents — an index claiming a digest that does not match the actual bytes is IMPORT_DIGEST_MISMATCH.

count.description: Number of findings/results in this file, for a cheap pre-parse sanity count.

path.description: Path relative to runs/<runId>/ to the detailed proving-tests.v1.json file (schemas/integrations/proving-tests.v1.schema.json), typically 'proving-tests.v1.json'.

count.description: Number of proving-test entries in that file, matching its own `tests` array length.
